attempts.sql: SELECT DISTINCT cls.symbol_id AS class_symbol_id, m.name AS method_name FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS cls JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.class_bases AS cb ON cb.class_symbol_id = cls.symbol_id JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS sqldb ON (cb.base_symbol_id = sqldb.symbol_id OR (cb.base_symbol_id IS NULL AND cb.base_name IN ('SQLDatabase', 'base.SQLDatabase'))) AND sqldb.kind = 'class' AND sqldb.name = 'SQLDatabase' AND sqldb.file_id = 'auto_ontology/connectors/base.py' JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.files AS f ON f.file_id = cls.file_id JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS m ON m.file_id = cls.file_id AND m.kind = 'method' AND m.qualname = cls.qualname || '.' || m.name AND m.line_start > cls.line_start AND m.line_end <= cls.line_end AND LEFT(m.name, 1) <> '_' WHERE cls.kind = 'class' AND f.is_test = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS sm WHERE sm.file_id = sqldb.file_id AND sm.kind = 'method' AND sm.qualname = sqldb.qualname || '.' || sm.name AND sm.name = m.name AND sm.line_start > sqldb.line_start AND sm.line_end <= sqldb.line_end AND LEFT(sm.name, 1) <> '_') ORDER BY class_symbol_id, method_name

request:
The production database connectors are the classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (defined in auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding any class defined in test code (every file under a tests/ folder counts as test code). For each such connector class, which public methods does the class define in its own body that SQLDatabase itself does not define? A method is public when its name does not start with an underscore (so __init__ and other dunder methods are excluded); anything written with def directly in the class body counts as a method, including properties and context-manager methods. Methods inherited without being redefined do not count. Return one row per (connector class symbol ID, method name).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), method_name (string).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This lists, for every production connector class that directly subclasses the SQLDatabase class defined in the connectors base module, the public methods the class declares in its own body. Methods are matched to their class by their qualified name and definition line range, public means the name does not start with an underscore, and classes in test files are excluded. Any method that SQLDatabase itself declares is removed, and each class-and-method pair appears once, ordered by class symbol ID and then method name.
